description: Results of the Codex 0.164.0 app server's account/rateLimits/read, in the shape `codex app-server generate-ts` shows (GetAccountRateLimitsResponse: rateLimits, a RateLimitSnapshot of primary and secondary windows, each usedPercent 0 to 100, windowDurationMins, resetsAt in Unix seconds). Synthetic values; no account was read. Each case gives the observations limitsFromRateLimits reads at observedAt, or that it reads none.

cases.case: a plan account mid-window: each window named by its length; credits and the plan type are not read
the shorter window used up: rejected until its reset; a share past 100 reads as 100; a window that is null is no reading
a window of no stated length: used up, window * (every window of the pool); not used up, no reading
a reset not believed: already past on a used-up window, or more than 400 days away; the share still stands
no window reported: no reading, nothing unreadable
wrong unit: a reset as an ISO string
cases.unreadable: its primary window is not in the checked shape

cases.case: wrong unit: a window's length in hours, not whole minutes
cases.unreadable: its secondary window is not in the checked shape
its primary window is not in the checked shape
its primary window reports a used share that is not a percentage

cases.case: bad shape: a window that is a number, so nothing in the answer is believed
cases.unreadable: its secondary window is not in the checked shape
